name: sftp-folder-probe
summary: Manual-invocation hook that maps an IP-allowlisted SFTP from Rossum's own egress — tree, extension casing, read-back, staging, quarantine.

entity_marker.description: case-insensitive filename token marking the files under investigation (e.g. a per-entity prefix); every other file is reported as the incumbent's

provenance: Built during an AP entity onboarding against an IP-allowlisted customer SFTP (2026-09), then rebuilt from scratch when it was needed again — which is why it is here. Run against two live accounts; this generalized form has not been re-run.
notes: ASK THE USER BEFORE DEPLOYING IT — it can write and move files on a customer SFTP. Never attach it to a queue (queues: []), and delete it when the investigation ends. Writes no schema field, so produces/consumes are legitimately empty.
